title: 2_4_Howards_Secret

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever tried a long distance relationship?
options: No, but I'd be willing to try!
No, and I don't want to.

question_options.question: Have you ever taken a Psychology class?

nodes.text: The other students talk happily.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sports tournaments?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heck yeah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: A Hollywood Prom? Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: It'll be `so` glamorous!
nodes.text_bbcode: It'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] glamorous!

nodes.text: The audience bursts into applause.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Remember to vote for $ZOE!
Taylor dismisses the assembly, then draws $ZOE to the side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice speech.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm glad you didn't embarrass me up there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks. I think.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, it's totally a good thing. If I like you, the people like you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And if they like you, they'll vote for you for Social Chair in November.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... Do they like me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you serious? Haven't you heard what they've been saying?
$ZOE's phone beeps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's him!
$ZOE grabs a sweater from her closet and pulls it on over her sundress.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You look great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bye, Sam!
Howard guides his car to a stop along the curb outside $ZOE's house.
$ZOE flies towards the car, and the grin on her face makes Howard smile.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is a sight I missed... Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because you've made a budget before?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, no...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you know exactly what amount you're going to budget out for everything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it'll take a bit of `research...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it'll take a bit of [color=#3b78e2][i]research...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe it's going to be a little hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'll finish it. No worries.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No matter how long it takes. I'm going to stay up until I finish it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just be careful, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will. You know I will.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's taking me to the amusement park.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The amusement park? That's like forty-five minutes away. Aren't you going to be out late?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you're starting to sound like your mom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I know. But seriously, don't you have that budget thing to turn in to Taylor tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of good things are going on in my life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if my relationship with Howard will work out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But right now, I'm happy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right. I'll... I'll be happy for you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ease up? Go with the flow?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I can't! You're my cousin, $ZOE. We have to look out for each other!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it just seems like you're looking to blame Howard!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone has to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard wouldn't hurt me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you know, that's exactly what I thought of Nick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's different!
$ZOE sees the hurt look on Sam's face and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or at least I hope it is. Howard is different. I thought you liked him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I do... But I like you more.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Howard` didn't have to watch you go all emo and mopey for three months.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard[/i][/color] didn't have to watch you go all emo and mopey for three months.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you two should fight over Owen.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, $ZOE. We'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You just get ready for your date with Howard!
$ZOE walks towards the parking lot, as the cheerleaders chatter away.
At home, Sam helps $ZOE prepare for her date with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think I should wear my cute flower top or my green sundress?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm surprised you haven't run out of 'date' clothes already.
$ZOE pulls on her green sundress.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You two have been on a date every single night for the past week. Since the fundraiser, you two have been inseparable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought you and Howard were over. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's complicated...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't we just talk about you and Nick?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you don't want to talk about something complicated, that's the wrong thing to pick at.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's not going to distract me. Tell me what's going on.
$ZOE's mind wanders back to the week before...
At the end of the fundraiser, $ZOE thanks Howard for bringing the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I would've done this for you any day. I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still in love with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't have to say anything. Or do anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know that we can pick up where we left off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All I know is that I want to see you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We don't have to go anywhere specific or do anything in particular, but can we just spend more time together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You two are going out, but you're not dating.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. We haven't even kissed yet! We're just trying to see if anything is still there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've been on so many dates, you're practically back together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just like spending time with him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So do people who date, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Forget it, Sam. No matter what we are right now, I still want to see him before he goes out of town.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And when is that exactly? He's already been here for a week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's on break.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For what holiday?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vernal Equinox.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And now I'm suspicious again.
$ZOE shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, can't you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, gross. Deep? I hate it when guys are all brainy and have backstory.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Way too much talking.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, he's not your type.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Too bad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I threw Nicole off... But I don't even know why I reacted like that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe `you're` not into that stuff, but I enjoy a guy who has some depth to him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] not into that stuff, but I enjoy a guy who has some depth to him.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And Owen is one of the most popular guys in school right now.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, I haven't given up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe you're not his type. Maybe Owen is into brunettes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't you dare, Maria. You `always` steal my cute guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you dare, Maria. You [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] steal my cute guys.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Troubled like a rebel?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They're so exciting. And mysterious. And handsome. And Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, not always that last one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what if Nicole's interested? It's not my business anymore.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I agree, Nicole. Bad boys are definitely hot right now.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: If you want to date him, you're going to have to trample me first.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Gladly. In high heels.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, so the Student Council meets tomorrow morning at 7:30 sharp.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You have until that time to get me a solid budget. Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! See you tomorrow!
After the assembly, $ZOE hums happily while the cheerleaders talk around her.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You seem really happy, $ZOE... I always hum when I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just feels like everything's going my way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got the endorsement from Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm creating the budget for the Halloween Dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm going out with Howard tonight!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You are really lucky. Dating a college guy is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, we're not `exactly` dating...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, we're not [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] dating...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I get it... Being exclusive isn't `in` at the moment.
nodes.text_bbcode: I get it... Being exclusive isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] at the moment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, no... It's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey! Look alive, guys! Hottie at twelve o'clock!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Twelve o'clock? Lunchtime! Woop woop!
Nicole waves at Owen who's walking their way.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hi, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hi, Nicole...
Everyone says hello to Owen. When he looks at $ZOE, he smiles.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, I heard Taylor's speech. Congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that means you're a shoo-in for the position.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Half a shoe, then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. Taylor did just put me in charge of making a budget for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... Good?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just glad she trusts me. Good thing I'm in that finance class, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, uh, the finance class started yesterday, but I didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I, uh, already took a class like that at my old school, so I'm taking Psychology instead.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, I was hoping we'd have at least one class together this quarter.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's too bad. Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe we can hang out sometime?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. I'll see you around, okay?
Owen walks away.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Poor guy... He looks so `single.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Poor guy... He looks so [color=#3b78e2][i]single.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just think how much happier he'd be with a `redhead` on his arm.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just think how much happier he'd be with a [color=#3b78e2][i]redhead[/i][/color] on his arm.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Ha ha, Nicole, you're so obvious.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sometimes you have to be if you want to get a date.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So $ZOE, you and Owen are real close. What do you think of him? Should I ask him out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Owen is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want Nicole to go out with Owen. What should I say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Always eager to please.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aren't you cute?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every girl knows how to `spend` money.
nodes.text_bbcode: Every girl knows how to [color=#3b78e2][i]spend[/i][/color] money.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want you to do the opposite.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course, Taylor. I get it. I won't go overboard, I swear.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Um... Spend?
The other students murmur.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Is it me, or do those ideas suck?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Those don't sound fun at all!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: They don't `smell` fun either!
nodes.text_bbcode: They don't [color=#3b78e2][i]smell[/i][/color] fun either!

nodes.text: Taylor takes the stand away from $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Doesn't she have a great sense of humor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What she means is that she's going to put on all the events you love! So vote for her!
Taylor dismisses the assembly then draws $ZOE to the side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I went through all the trouble of endorsing you, and all you can say is `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I went through all the trouble of endorsing you, and all you can say is [color=#3b78e2][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor...
But even though $ZOE's speech wasn't that inspiring...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Pleasure doing business with you. We'll talk soon.
Nate walks out.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
The next day, Class President Taylor addresses everyone at an after school assembly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is my least favorite topic, but... `Dress code.` Ladies, skirts can't be higher than two inches above the knees.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my least favorite topic, but... [color=#3b78e2][i]Dress code.[/i][/color] Ladies, skirts can't be higher than two inches above the knees.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know that's depressing, but apparently no one cares if that's fashionable or not.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But, hey, last thing on the list. And this should cheer everyone up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The vote for the school's new Social Chair will be held at the Halloween Dance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And now, a Social Chair candidate who has already proven herself to be great for the job...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's resourceful and responsible! In fact, she brought in the most money during the fundraiser we held last week!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Give it up for $ZOE!
$ZOE walks on stage, and Taylor steps away to let her take the podium.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello, everyone! Please vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have a lot of great ideas for the rest of the school year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As Social Chair, I'll make sure the school hosts...
Grudgingly, Nate hands over a crisp bill.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: This is what you mean, isn't it?
Wes holds the bill up against the light of the scanner. He grins.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I seem to have found my motivation in life.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That's great. Hurry up and get started before I slap that grin off your face.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ever the elegant negotiator...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Shut up.
Wes quickly pockets the money.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm going to walk out.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unexpected move, Crawford.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You didn't give me anything, and I'm not paying for another dead end.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, so what's your plan now? How are you going to win $ZOE back?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: By my calculations, with Howard in the way, you're third in line.
Nate stops.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's going to be awfully hard to get back into her good graces as it is.
Nate turns and hands Wes a crisp bill. Wes clears his throat, and Nate hands him another bill.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You'd better find something this time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I always do.

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: $ZOE fills in the last line right as Sam's car screeches to a halt in front of the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, Sam! I'll let you know what happens!
$ZOE opens the door and runs out.
A minute later, she plunges into the Student Council's meeting room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry! I slept straight through my alarm and--
She stops suddenly, taking stock of the room.
Taylor and Justin are glaring at her from their seats, but all $ZOE can see is Paige at the front of the room, grinning.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're late.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... But I did bring my proposal for the budget.
Justin looks it over skeptically.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The numbers are right...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh good!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was doing some last minute calculations in the car, and I wasn't sure if they worked.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Unfortunately, while the math is fine, you're overspending how much we've allocated.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Is that bad?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's definitely not `great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's definitely not [color=#3b78e2][i]great.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And after Paige's well-researched budget... It's going to be hard `endorsing` yours.
nodes.text_bbcode: And after Paige's well-researched budget... It's going to be hard [color=#3b78e2][i]endorsing[/i][/color] yours.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All I can see on this page are huge blanks where the numbers go, some doodles of flowers, and a unicorn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought they would be pretty?
Justin swings back to the front, his attention back on Paige.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm just glad `some` members of the student body took the assignment seriously.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just glad [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] members of the student body took the assignment seriously.

nodes.text: Paige clears her throat, causing Taylor to turn as well.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: As I was saying before $ZOE ruined the moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If we make some major cutbacks in the decorations department due to my dad's rather extensive network of connections, we can spend more on food and music!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good work, Paige. I wasn't sure what to expect when you said you'd created your own budget.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm impressed. You've really thought this through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought I was in charge of the budget...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And now you're not.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paige did a better job than you, $ZOE, and I'm going to use her budget to start arguing for funds for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's going to get around that you took Paige's side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about the endorsement?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, I want the best person for this job.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And after today, I just don't know if you're it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But who's going to organize the Halloween Dance?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll think about it. Okay? Right now, I have to go to the principal.
Taylor and Justin leave the room, and Paige gives $ZOE a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, `someone` just got dumped. And look at that, it wasn't me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] just got dumped. And look at that, it wasn't me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Halloween Dance budget was `my` project.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Halloween Dance budget was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] project.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I stole it from right under your nose.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to thank you, though. If your budget didn't suck so much, they never would have gone with mine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I hope whatever kept you away was worth it.
Paige flounces out of the room, leaving $ZOE standing alone.
You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 4: Howard's Secret!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 2, Episode 4: Howard's Secret![/b]

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, maybe not enough for a good DJ.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But good enough for a mediocre one with a limited music selection!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure that's close enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My brain's stuck!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's 58 dollars! Maybe. I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'm almost done.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have 100 dollars for entertainment. We've spent 27 dollars to rent extra speakers for the gym.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How much is left?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does that even make sense?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just write it down! We're almost to the school!
$ZOE writes it down and continues.
$ZOE hastily scribbles it down!
$ZOE draws a blank!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe $50?
$ZOE moves on to the next item.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have 100 dollars specifically for renting decorations.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can put 20 percent aside for buying new supplies...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's 20 percent of 100 dollars?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's right! One hundred minus sixty `is` forty!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right! One hundred minus sixty [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] forty!

nodes.text: $ZOE writes it down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, does that sound right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I'm trying not to kill pedestrians here!
$ZOE shakes her head and writes down the first number that comes into her head.
$ZOE's pencil hovers uncertainly over the blank on her sheet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it 30?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just going to lay my head down for a second. It's just a little too bright in here.
$ZOE puts her head on her desk, and in no time, her eyes drift shut.
The next morning, Sam is snoring contentedly into her pillow when...
$ZOE bursts in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! Wake up! Quick!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I overslept, I didn't finish the budget, and the Student Council meeting starts in ten minutes! Help, please!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know I suck at math.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not going to do math. I just need you to drive me. Now!
Sam stumbles into her closet, pulls on some clothes, and runs with $ZOE to the car.
In the car, $ZOE scribbles furiously onto a sheet of paper titled 'Halloween Dance Budget'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so if I carry the two, we'll spend six thousand dollars on Christmas lights!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, six thousand dollars? It's a dance, not a light show! That's got to be wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right. Shoot. I can't do it when I'm all panicky!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Breathe,` $ZOE. `Breathe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Breathe,[/i][/color] $ZOE. [color=#3b78e2][i]Breathe.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The numbers spin in front of $ZOE, but she focuses until they stay put.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I have to do this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so 60 percent of the money we have for the dance goes into snacks and decorations.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How much is left for everything else?
At a nearby cafe, Howard and $ZOE sit in one of the large booths.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I remember the first time we went to get coffee together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted to impress you so much...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the only stories I could think of were about all the pranks my twin sisters used to pull on me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was sweet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's how I knew we were meant to be together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And now... $ZOE, I have to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Howard's on break. So what? Everyone knows that! Tell me something I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: If that's the only thing you have on him, then I want all my money back!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Does no one here understand how college works?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: There is `no such thing` as 'Vernal Equinox' break.
nodes.text_bbcode: There is [color=#e23b3b][i]no such thing[/i][/color] as 'Vernal Equinox' break.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I don't see how this is going to help me break them up.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Let me spell it out.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Howard `lied.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard [color=#e23b3b][i]lied.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And you of all people should know what happens when you lie to $ZOE.
A smile spreads across Nate's face.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Good work. I guess that's why I pay you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And why you owe me a favor.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fine, yes, whatever. I can't wait to see the look on $ZOE's face when I tell her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I haven't been completely honest with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The truth is...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The truth is that there's no school break. I'm not on vacation.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I lied. I made it up. The Vernal Equinox is in spring anyway. It was stupid, I know, but I panicked.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't understand. If you're not on break, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I spent the first month at college immersing myself in my classes, in my clubs, in the Kingston King program.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I was doing really well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I wasn't happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you dropped out of school and lied to cover it up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't drop out! I left. I'm still enrolled, but I'm just not attending all my classes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, that's not like you. What about your future? You're throwing that away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And what about our future? I don't want to throw that away either.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I may have lied to you about how I got here, but I never lied about `why`.
nodes.text_bbcode: I may have lied to you about how I got here, but I never lied about [color=#e23b3b][i]why[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I came back because nothing I achieved in college could make up for `you.` For what I felt for you. For what we had.
nodes.text_bbcode: I came back because nothing I achieved in college could make up for [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] For what I felt for you. For what we had.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I came back because I love you, and I want us to be together again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, when you left... It was hard. Really hard. And now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I don't have all the answers...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just know how I feel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that was enough for me to drop everything and come back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what I've been wondering all this time is...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it enough for you?
Howard meets her eyes, his face awash with hope.
And $ZOE thinks about all the times they had together and takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...It is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It is enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know how we're going to make it work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we'll figure out a way.
Later, $ZOE skips into her room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and me... Together again...
She sits on her bed, changes into her pajamas, and curls into bed happily.
Then, suddenly, one thought pushes through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The budget!
A few minutes later, $ZOE is sitting at a desk in the den. She pulls out a blank sheet of paper from her binder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so if we do a Halloween dance, we'll need decorations...
She writes down 'Decorations'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that costs...
$ZOE yawns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That costs three hundred pillows--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, `dollars!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]dollars![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Round that to the nearest ten, and--
She lets out another big yawn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to stay awake! Must... Fight... Sleep...
But $ZOE can't resist sleep any longer. She has no choice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, I had a great time tonight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm so excited for our date tomorrow! You have no idea!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me too!
$ZOE skips into her room and closes the door. Sam comes in a minute later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, how was it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was perfect. We went on the carousel, I won him a prize, `and` we went boating!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was perfect. We went on the carousel, I won him a prize, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] we went boating!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you didn't talk about when he's going back or what's going to happen when he does?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told you, Sam. He's on vacation. Besides, it just didn't seem like the right time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll talk about it when it comes up.
And for the next couple weeks...
Howard and $ZOE keep going on more and more dates.
They eat fancy meals at fancy places...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't know they made forks so tiny!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know there was a wrong way to eat!
They catch basketball games...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, dunk it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go, winning team!
They spend more and more time together until it starts affecting $ZOE's personal life...
In the hallways...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So then I told Nick that he was being silly. Of course I wasn't `really` going to smash his camera.
nodes.text_bbcode: So then I told Nick that he was being silly. Of course I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] going to smash his camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But sometimes, when you're angry, you sound like you're serious.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard... Butt out.
In class...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did I ever tell you how much I love having you in my life?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... But I wish you wouldn't do it... When class has already started...
Howard seems to notice the rest of the class staring at them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry.
And then one day, $ZOE and Howard come home and find Sam and the cheerleaders in her bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi guys... What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is an intervention.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For you and Howard. You two are spending way too much time with each other!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like you've become the same person!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't get me started on what your issues are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you two want to be together, that's fine. But what you're doing is not good for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And in Howard's case, it's just plain creepy.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but she's right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you all feel this way?
The girls all nod in unison.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad. Because Howard and I were meant to be. And no one can take that away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not my school, not his university, and certainly not your intervention!
$ZOE runs out of the room, taking Howard with her.
Uh-oh! Looks like $ZOE might be taking things a little too far with Howard!
Maybe if $ZOE had stopped to ask Howard a few more pointed questions, she could have balanced her life better.
One thing's for sure...
$ZOE has failed.
Try again and see if you can help $ZOE figure out what's going on between her and Howard!

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At any rate, we should paddle back. It's getting late. I'll take you home.
They paddle back to shore.
Later, Howard pulls in front of $ZOE's house. He lets the car idle as they sit in silence.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I guess I'll see you tomorrow night then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your first night here, you talked about a dance you went to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't realize it until now, but you told me where it was and what you did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you never even said it was 'fun' or 'cool' or 'exciting'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that's true of everything you've said about Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even now, you said 'People think college is awesome', but why don't `you` think it's awesome?
nodes.text_bbcode: Even now, you said 'People think college is awesome', but why don't [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] think it's awesome?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've never even said you `liked` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've never even said you [color=#3b78e2][i]liked[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: College is fine. I've just been having a hard time getting used to it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want you to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm happy with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not what I wanted to hear...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What gives you that impression?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: From all the stories you've told me, it sounds like you have a lot on your plate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm worried that you're spending too much time with me when you could be studying or something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm doing `fine` in school, I promise. I'm doing well in all my classes.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, I'm doing [color=#e23b3b][i]fine[/i][/color] in school, I promise. I'm doing well in all my classes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My professors are happy with my work. I'm all set to get 'A's this semester.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't have to worry about it.
A sudden movement catches $ZOE's eye.
A mother duck and her baby ducklings have swum alongside the boat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, look... Ducklings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They used to be our animal.
Howard turns to face her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Used to be'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that. But what are we, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're going back to college in... In...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, how long are you here for exactly?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: As long as you need me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But school must start up again soon. You can't have this much time off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I do. I'm pretty lucky. Besides, no one monitors you in college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: People think college is awesome like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can sleep in and skip a class or two. As long as you turn in the papers and show up for the tests, you're fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You just spend the rest of the time hanging out with friends.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, it seems like you're not very...

nodes.prompt: Howard, it seems like you're not very...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Howard, it seems like you're not very...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They are the reason you went to Kingston University in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My first year's all about general ed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a little like high school since I'm in so many different classes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm taking calculus, an animal biology class, and an American history class.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You wouldn't believe how hard biology is. I have so much lab homework that I'm swimming in it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the worst part is the midterm and the final count so much towards my grade.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, am I taking up too much of your time? Shouldn't you be studying during the break?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I study all day. Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why does that not comfort me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean? You've been there for most of it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, your break. What's the deal with the Equinox?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never even heard of it. So why does your school celebrate it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's the changing of the seasons...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but it's not like `Thanksgiving` or `New Year's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but it's not like [color=#3b78e2][i]Thanksgiving[/i][/color] or [color=#3b78e2][i]New Year's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's still `tradition.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But it's still [color=#e23b3b][i]tradition.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can we stop with the questions about my break?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not about to question getting a long vacation mid-semester.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He seems so defensive about it... Which makes me think Sam is onto something...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry I asked.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay. Really. But it seems like bad luck to talk about it all the time.
$ZOE shakes it off and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, what's next?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see a place where we can get boats. Want to go there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Lead the way.
They find a gigantic lake where boats bump peacefully in the water.
$ZOE and Howard grab a paddleboat and start paddling their way to the middle of the lake.
At the center, they sit, their boat spinning in lazy circles.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the life, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's like nothing out here can touch us. It's just you and me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Together.
He puts an arm around $ZOE, and she leans into it. Worry creeps into her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This won't last. When does he go back? I don't know how to bring it up without sounding weird.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to know the truth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're caught up on everything I've done. And it seems like we always talk about me when we go out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell me about your...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Winter` Equinox?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Winter[/i][/color] Equinox?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said 'Vernal' earlier. Isn't that different?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I'm pretty sure I said 'Winter'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, 'Vernal'... 'Winter'... They're both seasons. Does it matter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess not...
$ZOE hesitates.
By the time she decides to ask Howard about his slip-up, he's taken their food leftovers to the nearest trash.
Their eyes meet. He leans in...
And $ZOE turns away.
Nate turns away from Wes angrily.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You didn't find anything?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Not on the surface. I checked his family history, his football track record, his prior run-ins with the law...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And nothing? Not one `speck` of `dirt` on him?
nodes.text_bbcode: And nothing? Not one [color=#e23b3b][i]speck[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]dirt[/i][/color] on him?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Nothing that would make you look cooler by comparison.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And nothing that $ZOE doesn't already know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What am I paying you for?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm getting there. So I dug deeper.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I moved on to his university records and checked out his academic history, his grades, his extracurriculars...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Let me guess. He's a total loser. College doesn't agree with him.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You'd be wrong. He's acing his classes, and people love him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I don't know `why.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know [color=#e23b3b][i]why.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Maybe not, but that doesn't change the fact that there's nothing on him there, either.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And we're back at square one!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But I did happen to uncover an interesting piece of gossip.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: He told $ZOE that he was on break for Kingston's Vernal Equinox celebration...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, let's get on a ride! It's time to celebrate!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which one do you want to go on? The Panther Pit? Death Flame Spiral? The Manmaker?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are those rides? They sound scary!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess the names aren't really helping out. What about the carousel?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds perfect.
They wait in line for the carousel. When they reach the front, Howard helps $ZOE onto a white horse with flower reins.
He takes the black horse next to hers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You look very professional on that plastic horse.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So do you, sir. So do you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hope we can have a night like this every night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Every` night?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Every[/i][/color] night?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's what I said.
$ZOE looks out at the park as the carousel spins around and around...
And her thoughts wander back to what Sam said earlier about Howard and his plans for staying.
When the ride ends, Howard buys $ZOE some treats from a snack bar.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cotton candy for your thoughts?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, please. I was just thinking about how pretty all the lights are.
She gestures at the carnival lights twinkling throughout the park like fireflies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's really something, isn't it? I've missed this city a lot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, you must have. You're spending your entire break over here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you can't waste your, uh... Your Winter Equinox on just anything.
The ball strikes the two bottom bottles. The structure teeters precariously... And falls!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Strike!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Congrats to the little lady! Pick your prize!
$ZOE selects a fuzzy teddy bear and hands it to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Won you something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll treasure it always.
He looks down at her.
The ball misses the bottles by inches.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: That's too bad, miss! A dollar for another go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's okay... I was never really `great` at sports...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's okay... I was never really [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] at sports...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not true. You caught a football on one of our first dates.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It wasn't a date. And yes, I did.
She grins up at him.
$ZOE confuses herself, and the ball veers right!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Now, about Howard...
Wes starts telling Nate what he knows.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Meanwhile...
Howard and $ZOE walk into the amusement park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was surprised to see an amusement park in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, they built it right after you left for college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Have you been here yet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. It's my first time coming here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then we'll make sure you have a good time.
He takes her hand, and the touch feels foreign to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to be so close. Why does it feel weird now?
She grips Howard's hand tighter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where do you want to go first?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like to try my hand at some real carnival games...
They step up to a booth where three milk bottles are stacked into a triangle. Howard tosses $ZOE a softball.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Step right up! Step right up! First one to knock all the bottles down gets a huge prize!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First one's on me. Let's see that arm! Throw it low!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right! I'll win something you'll be proud to take home to your parents...
$ZOE winds up and throws the ball at the...

nodes.prompt: How do you throw the ball?

menu.title: Choose quickly!
menu.text: How do you throw the ball?

nodes.text: He shoves Wes against a car.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm tired of your stupid games. Don't mess with me, or you're going to get a lot worse than a shove.
Wes straightens out, dusting the sleeves of his shirt.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I wouldn't be so quick to threaten, Crawford.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Because I can make you regret it.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Everyone has secrets, and I already know enough about you and your family to make the media go crazy.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A guy with a family like yours has a lot to lose.
Nate balls his fists... But instead of slugging Wes, he reaches into his pocket and hands Wes a twenty.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You know what? This time, it's double.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Double?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And you owe me a favor.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wes...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unless you want the local news to pick up an `interesting` story about your daddy... Pay up.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you want the local news to pick up an [color=#e23b3b][i]interesting[/i][/color] story about your daddy... Pay up.

nodes.text: Nate gives Wes another bill.
Nate resists the urge to shove Wes against a car.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not paying you another cent until you give me something I can use! I've paid you enough.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Sure. You're right. No charge for this one.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Of course. For such a loyal customer, my only fee is one very small favor.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Sounds like you just made a deal.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Just tell me what you know.
Unsure what to do, Nate goes with instinct!
You are now playing as Nate.
Across town, Nate guides his car to a stop in an isolated parking lot.
Wes walks over.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Good to know you can follow directions...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not your lackey. Tell me what I want to know.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: If you're looking for dirt on Howard... There isn't any.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What I'm hearing is that `you messed up.` You don't have anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: What I'm hearing is that [color=#e23b3b][i]you messed up.[/i][/color] You don't have anything.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And you're supposed to be the best.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What I `said` was that I didn't have any `dirt.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#e23b3b][i]said[/i][/color] was that I didn't have any [color=#e23b3b][i]dirt.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What do you have?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, how badly do you want to know?
Around them, the students chatter excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE's definitely my top pick!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love her cupcakes! Which means I love her!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She's like a celebrity, and `celebrities` always win! Social Chair is hers!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's like a celebrity, and [color=#3b78e2][i]celebrities[/i][/color] always win! Social Chair is hers!

nodes.text: Nearby, Paige looks on, a disgusted expression on her face.
At the front, Taylor walks $ZOE offstage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, $ZOE. The endorsement's just the beginning.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you're going to be Social Chair, you'll have to do a lot more. Your duties aren't just cupcakes and dunk tanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'll have to be, like, responsible. In other words, I have a really boring task for you. I'm trusting you with the budget for the Halloween Dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so... So...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Disappointed? Mind-numbingly bored?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excited!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're the only person I know who'd be excited to do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! But just one question...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do I make a budget?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have a folder here with all the information. We have a set amount of money for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Figure out how much you want us to put into decorations, food, and other stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Do not go over budget.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Do not go over budget.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can do that! Don't worry, Taylor, I know how to...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Meanwhile...
Howard and $ZOE walk into the amusement park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was surprised to see an amusement park in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, they built it right after you left for college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Have you been here yet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. It's my first time coming here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then we'll make sure you have a good time.
He takes her hand, and the touch feels foreign to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to be so close. Why does it feel weird now?
She grips Howard's hand tighter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where do you want to go first?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like to try my hand at some real carnival games...
They step up to a booth where three milk bottles are stacked into a triangle. Howard tosses $ZOE a softball.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Step right up! Step right up! First one to knock all the bottles down gets a huge prize!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First one's on me. Let's see that arm! Throw it low!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right! I'll win something you'll be proud to take home to your parents...
$ZOE winds up and throws the ball at the...

Wes walks over.

The next day, Owen walks into his first Psychology class.
Not seeing anyone he knows, Owen sits down at the nearest desk and flips through his Psych textbook.
Maybe it's not the class I wanted, but it's better this way.
Who knows? Maybe I'll meet someone new...
And that's when Paige slips into the seat next to him.
If it isn't $ZOE's favorite boy toy!
Why are you sitting next to me?
It's a free country, isn't it?
Yeah, and I'm free to ignore you.
He turns away, but she continues to talk to him.
You know, I hear $ZOE and Howard are getting really serious now.
But I just don't know if it's good for her to go out with some college guy. Long distance never works out.
People are saying she's totally lost it.
$ZOE's free to do what she wants.
It's good that you think that way.
The sooner you stop seeing yourself as $ZOE's lapdog, the sooner you'll realize you need to jump ship before it sinks.
What's that supposed to mean?
Social Chair. It's mine.
Yeah right.
Ask Taylor. I just got her unofficial endorsement.
And unlike $ZOE, I'm playing to win.
Owen starts to say something else, but then Mr. Dean walks through the door.
Welcome to Psychology 1. I'll be your teacher.
Part of psychology is delving into your own psyche. So we're going to start this year with a special assignment.
We're going to do class introductions. But you won't be responsible for your own.
Each of you will pair up with a random person from the class.
I'll explain the details of the project after I tell you who your partner is.
This project will be incredibly involved... Intensive... And deeply personal. Shall we begin?
Mr. Dean reads down the list of names until...
And Owen, your partner will be...
Paige!
What? Seriously?!
Looks like Owen and Paige have some rough times ahead of them!
That's your bonus scene!

nodes.text: You are now playing as Nate.
Late one night...
Nate walks into the school's library and finds Wes standing at the copy machine.
The light from the machine's scanner flashes, and Wes plucks a sheet from the machine's tray.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Side project. I have a few clients that want some assurance they'll pass Mr. Dean's mid-term on Friday.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Nothing to do with you...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unless you're flunking English.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'd rather just get what I paid for.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you sure? The last time you asked me to get info on someone $ZOE liked, it didn't turn out so well for you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was just trying to protect her. $ZOE will see that eventually.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So she hasn't talked to you since she found out you lied to her.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So what makes you think it'll work this time?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: This time, she'll see that I'm the best guy for her. Now just tell me you have some dirt on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I did the standard search... And didn't get much. He's a straight arrow, that guy.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No one's that clean.  There must be `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No one's that clean.  There must be [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm sure there is, but it'll take a little more... `Incentive` to find it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure there is, but it'll take a little more... [color=#e23b3b][i]Incentive[/i][/color] to find it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You ask too much.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, but someone has to. What are you going to do about it?

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
